 Hello Jack, 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 In just 1 hour, today—Saturday, September 13, 2025, at 9:00 a.m. (EST, GMT-5:00)— the Lasclay Fall Pre-Sale 2025 begins on lasclay.com (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_0). 

 

 New products: 
 

 In addition to our pioneer products ( mittens (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_1) , scarves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_2) , neck warmers (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_3) , beanies (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_4) , insoles (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_5) , insulated bags (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_6) , oven mitts (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_7) , outdoor cushions (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_8) , insulated phone cases (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_9) , etc.), several new milkweed-based products will be available: 

 
 
 Warm, lightweight and colorful urban mittens (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_10) that are just as warm and more affordable than our very popular classic milkweed mittens (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_11).

 

 Innovative coats and sleeveless jackets (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_12) that come with removable milkweed insulation, so you can also use them when it gets warmer outside 

 Milkweed & recycled merino wool baby mitts (click here to see (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_13))

 Eco-friendly pet cushions in 3 sizes (click here to see (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_14))

 Several spin-off products from our special collections, including some new ones :

 
 Collabs (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_15) , where we showcase products from other companies or artisans who share our values and love for milkweed / monarchs. 
 
 

 Materials (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_16), where we offer raw milkweed products for artists and DIYers such as pure silk (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_17), moisturizing milkweed seed oil (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_18), and milkweed insulating fabric / batting (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_19) for sewing, or for insulating beehives, RVs, and more!

 

 The Imperfects (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_20), our anti-waste initiative. Products with minor cosmetic flaws, returns, or repairs, offered at reduced prices. 

 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why this once-a-year event is crucial for the future of Lasclay, the milkweed industry and monarch butterflies

 
 This pre-sale is about so much more than getting a high-performance coat at a discounted price. It’s a turning point for the future of Lasclay and the survival of monarchs in North America.

 We’ve reached a critical moment. 

 Out of the more than 200 farmers who began growing common milkweed in the USA and Canada between 2013 and 2018, only 25 remain today. They urgently need income, hope, and market opportunities to keep this pioneering crop alive—one that’s become a lifeline for the endangered monarch butterfly.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 On the brink of extinction, monarchs made an inexplicable and remarkable comeback. Every summer, multiple generations of butterflies breed on milkweed plants before migrating back to their overwintering areas in Mexico. After which, we collect their gift: milkweed seed pods, containing precious insulating silk. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A female monarch laying eggs in an organic, commercial milkweed field. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A recent study from the University of Guelph (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_21) , covered by both Canadian and American media, highlights the urgency of the situation: monarch butterfly populations are alarmingly low . The researchers call for a coordinated North American action plan to protect and restore their populations before it’s too late. 

 Milkweed fields do just that and milkweed-based products are a great way to support them. 

 

 
 No matter which milkweed product you choose—whether it’s for winter, summer, or home— every purchase directly supports monarch butterflies by increasing the demand for milkweed, and in turn, supporting the profitability and long-term survival of milkweed fields— critical breeding grounds where monarchs thrive and drastically increase their numbers all summer long before embarking on their epic 4,000-mile migration through Canada, USA and Mexico. 

 With your support and trust, we can set this wheel in motion and pave the way toward a bright future for milkweed—elevating it to the status it truly deserves. That’s been our dream from day one. 

 This incredible plant deserves it. The monarch butterflies deserve it. The hardworking milkweed farmers deserve it. 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Are you ready to do your part in this great mission? 

 

 
 It’s possible to pre-order all products from our shop starting now, but exclusive promo codes will be available beginning September 13 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time for the first buyers of the season.

 IMPORTANT NOTE: Most of our customers are on the East Coast, which is why the launch starts at 9:00 a.m. If you’re on the West Coast and it is too early for you to get the 20% discount, just go ahead and place your order later on Saturday the 13th using the 15% off code . If you then email us at hey@lasclay.com , we’ll be happy to adjust your discount to 20%. 

 

 Here are the different discount codes and their time windows: 

 
 
 LASCLAY20 (20% off during the first 60 minutes, from 9:00 to 10:00 a.m. EST)

 LASCLAY15 (15% off for the rest of September 13, until 11:59 p.m. EST)

 LASCLAY12 (12% off all day Sunday, September 14) 

 
 To browse our full product catalog and make yourself a quick shopping list, just click the link below: 

 

 👉 https://lasclay.com/launch2025 👈 (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01K51E0GSAY7CY9PV68NKFMVG6_22) 

 

 I truly hope to see you today 😀

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Gabriel 
Founder
Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lasclay inc

Hi jack,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!
